titel: Danzels Laden: Bild, neue Kleidung, geänderte Texte
hinweis: Der Laden ist schon im Spiel und nutzt noch das Piazza-Bild. Beim Bild reicht ein OK für deinen Favoriten. Die sieben neuen Stücke sind noch nicht im Spiel, die drei geänderten Texte schon.

items.soll: Kleiner Schneiderladen an der Piazza: großes Fenster, roter Vorhang, eine Schneiderpuppe, Registrierkasse. Rechts Platz für Danzel.
Navy wool, cut so both shoulders sit exactly level. The tailor spent two nights on the left one, and he will tell you about it.
Dark velvet, lined in red where only the wearer can see. Made for an entrance. The tailor says it has never failed, then admits nobody has worn one yet.
Washed linen with one pocket cut for a waterproof notebook. Salt won't stain it. It was tested in a bucket of harbour water, and the tailor would like the bucket back.
Red cotton, stitched twice at every edge. So far it has survived a spanner, a fan belt and a hot pipe. It will not survive being called cute.

items.titel: NEU · The Plain Pullover · 70 € · liebt Siri
items.soll: Soft grey wool. No logo, no label, no colour that photographs well. Nobody will ask where it came from, and that is what you are paying for.
Heavy linen, with one pocket for a spoon and one that is nobody's business. Butter comes out. Whatever else ends up on it stays between you and the laundry.
Black silk with a long fringe that answers every turn of the shoulder a moment late. Cut for a real dance floor, and far too good for the one in this village.
A thick wool hat with a snowflake pattern, completely wrong for Corsica. It was ordered for a Norwegian guest years ago. He never came back for it.
Sheer black stockings with a lace top that stays up on its own. The invoice calls them “luxury textiles”, between the towels and the tablecloths.
Red and black, with ruffles that move like a skirt in the wind. It isn't for sale to just anyone.
